desc: Implement exact integer cube-root computation for \(N\le 10^{18}\).
Implement exact perfect-square checking and integer reconstruction of \(x,y\).
Enumerate \(d\), enforce divisibility and positivity/integrality conditions, and verify the original equation.
Confirm \(O(\sqrt[3]{N})\) time and \(O(1)\) extra space, then format the stdin/stdout Python code with the required delimiters.
Run the provided sample tests and confirm the implementation passes all of them.
